sn11.15:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ Jetavane || || Atha kho Sakko devānam indo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Sakko devānam indo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Kiṃ nu kho bhante bhūmirāmaṇeyyakan ti || ||
sn11.15:2.1: Ārāmacetyā vanacetyā || pokkharaññā sunimmitā || manussarāmaṇeyyassa || kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ || ||
sn11.15:3.1: gāme vā yadivāraññe || ninne vā yadivā thale || yattha arahanto viharanti || tam bhūmirāmaṇeyyakan ti || ||
